title: Item Components Repairable
description: Defines the items that can be used to repair a defined item, and the amount of durability each item restores upon repair. Each entry needs to define a list of strings for 'items' that can be used for the repair and an optional 'repair_amount' for how much durability is repaired.

repair_amount.description: How much the item is repaired.

repair_items.title: Repair Items
repair_items.description:
List of repair item entries. Each entry needs to define a list of strings for `items` that can be used for the repair and an optional `repair_amount` for how much durability is gained.

• chestplate: [{"items":["minecraft:stick"],"repair_amount":"...
• my_sword_chuck: [{"items":["minecraft:diamond"],"repair_amount"...
